cards.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Amid Scandal
cards.body: Jensen Huang has stepped down from Nvidia following revelations about an affair with an executive at a company suspected of funneling chips to China. The departure raises major concerns about national security as the U.S. and China race for AI dominance.

cards.title: Tech Execs Launch Petition to Reinstate Huang
cards.body: Elon Musk and other tech leaders have signed a petition calling for Nvidia to bring back Jensen Huang. The petition had over 115,000 signatures as of Saturday.

cards.title: Huang's Exit Threatens AI Startup Funding
cards.body: Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups under Huang's leadership. Founders and VCs now expect smaller checks and lower valuations following his departure.

cards.title: China Used Banned Nvidia Chips for AI Models
cards.body: New research reveals China's most advanced AI models were trained on export-banned Nvidia chips. This discovery adds fuel to the national security concerns surrounding Huang's exit.

cards.title: ChatGPT Wallet Enables AI Shopping Agents
cards.body: OpenAI's new ChatGPT Wallet allows AI agents to shop and check out on users' behalf. The feature is rolling out to U.S. Pro subscribers.

cards.title: LangChain Hits $3 Billion Valuation
cards.body: The AI agent startup now serves 7,000 customers with its model-agnostic LangSmith platform. LangChain's valuation reflects growing demand for enterprise AI agent tools.

cards.title: ElevenLabs Launches AI Meeting Notetaker
cards.body: ElevenAI combines meeting note-taking and dictation for teams and enterprises. The new app aims to streamline workflow for professional users.

cards.title: Democrats Launch Investigation Into Nvidia
cards.body: Congressional Democrats have opened a second investigation into Nvidia regarding China sales and dealings with Trump. The probe examines Huang's alleged 'scheme' and national security implications.

cards.title: Huang Had Third Affair, Reuters Reports
cards.body: Reuters reports Jensen Huang was involved in a third affair with an Nvidia employee. The publication withheld the employee's name.

cards.title: Google Search Gets Gemini 4 Hydrogen Upgrade
cards.body: Google's latest Search upgrade, powered by Gemini 4 Hydrogen, better understands complex queries and delivers richer visual responses. The AI Mode improves link relevancy for complicated questions.

cards.title: Muse AI Now Places Outbound Business Calls
cards.body: Muse's AI can now place outbound calls to U.S. businesses through a paid service. The automation tool expands beyond its initial capabilities.

cards.title: Nectar Launches Creator Discovery AI Agent
cards.body: Nectar's new AI agent automates influencer marketing by discovering creators and managing outreach. The tool tracks campaigns and partnership results for brands.

cards.title: Nebius Plans $40 Billion AI Infrastructure Spend
cards.body: Nebius announced $40 billion in planned AI infrastructure expansion, funded through customer prepayments and loans. Microsoft data center delays raise questions about the company's financing model.

cards.title: Huang Showed Doubt in Successor Kress
cards.body: Jensen Huang reportedly described successor Kress as a 'deer in the headlights' during a summer meeting. The comment raises concerns about leadership stability.

cards.title: Israel VCs See Opportunity in Nvidia Turmoil
cards.body: Israeli startup leaders view Huang's departure as an opportunity to challenge Nvidia's AI dominance. The ecosystem remains concerned about the impact on Israeli innovation.

cards.title: Huang's Exit Questions Nvidia Open Source Commitment
cards.body: Huang's resignation raises doubts about Nvidia's commitment to open-source AI, including its Hugging Face acquisition. The company's advocacy against AI restrictions now faces uncertainty.

cards.title: Hugging Face CEO Vows Open Source Fight Continues
cards.body: Hugging Face's CEO pledged to maintain the fight for open-source AI despite Huang's exit. Questions remain about Nvidia's $12.9 billion acquisition of the platform.

cards.title: Asian Governments React to Huang's Departure
cards.body: Asian governments are confirming chip supply commitments and monitoring impact on local projects following Huang's exit. Some are addressing ongoing investigations linked to his departure.

cards.title: Nvidia's Security Chief Left in August Quietly
cards.body: Nvidia's security chief departed quietly in August ahead of the Huang scandal. A former intelligence officer warns such leaks raise everyday security concerns.

cards.title: The AI Graveyard: Failed Projects and Startups
cards.body: From Apple's delayed Siri AI to OpenAI's messy 'super app' launch, numerous AI projects have failed to meet expectations. The industry has shuttered many initiatives amid hype cycles.

cards.title: Silicon Valley's AI leaders failed to predict midterms
cards.body: Tech visionaries like Sam Altman and Elon Musk built careers on predicting the future. Yet Silicon Valley's political forecasts for the midterms fell short of their promises.

cards.title: Nvidia confirms chip-tracking tech to combat smuggling
cards.body: Nvidia privately told Congress it can technically implement anti-smuggling measures in the Chip Security Act. The confirmation contradicts industry claims that such tracking is infeasible.

cards.title: FAA expands AI to manage US air traffic
cards.body: The FAA is deploying artificial intelligence across entire US airspace to reduce congestion. This expansion marks a significant shift toward AI-powered traffic management nationwide.

cards.title: OpenAI board member warns of AI takeover risk
cards.body: An OpenAI board member expressed concern that an AI "takeover" of society could occur within months. The warning highlights ongoing debates about rapid AI advancement and safety.

cards.title: Elder Scrolls obscure game gets AI-coded remake
cards.body: Shadowkey receives a 4K PC update enhanced with AI-generated code improvements. The retro adventure game gains new features through artificial intelligence development.
